build_Head_module: build a python module that instantiates the Head class with an options dict containing num_head_layers, bb_hidden_dim, anchor_scale, dataset, and decoder_num_classes
run_Head_forward: run the Head forward pass with a list of feature tensors to get classification logits and bounding box regression outputs
review_Head_init: review the Head __init__ to understand how cls_tower and bbox_tower Conv1d layers are constructed from the options dict
test_Head_forward: test the Head forward method by passing a list of torch tensors and verifying logits and bbox_reg are returned
refactor_Head_forward: refactor the Head forward method to support optional ReLU activation on bbox_pred for POINT regression type
